name: BLAST machine: 14 OPL2-style FM models
description: One extra machine after Chord with 14 two-operator FM models on SHAPE (SIN, HLF, ABS, PLS, BAS, PIA, MAR, GLK, BRS, ACC, STR, STL, TMP, ZAP), each at a fixed modulator:carrier ratio. COLOR is the FM index, SWEEP steps the ratio (shown as 1:2, 1:1 .. 9:1, 10X, 12X, 15X), CONTOUR moves the sound, PUNCH turns the chip's LFO on, DECAY and GATE as on Tone.
source: tools/machines/blast, package port of the standalone BLAST machine

uses.why: SHAPE shows the model names (SIN..ZAP) and SWEEP the ratio names (1:2..15X) instead of numbers; every other knob keeps the generic state
SWEEP steps through the ratio list one detent at a time (the value is the step's knob position), not one knob unit at a time

emulation.tool: none yet; the standalone BLAST was measured in its source tree

unchanged: every track that does not use BLAST

emulation.tool: tools/emu/test_blast.py in the real OS voice loop (Unicorn), on the composed alone build
